policy: historical results are RELABELLED, never overwritten; every defect carries a regression test

defects.old_behavior: agent_canary_bench requested max_tokens=128 with no reasoning_effort; gpt-oss-120b spent the entire budget on reasoning and returned content=None
defects.why_invalid: finish_reason=length with completion_tokens=64/64 means the model never emitted an answer. Scoring that as a capability failure measures the request, not the teacher.
affected_verdicts: gpt-oss capability profile — 9/12 tasks were unanswered, not wrong
defects.fix: max_tokens default 1024, reasoning_effort=low, reasoning_content/tool_call extraction fallback, strip_thinking() for inline <think> blocks
defects.new_interpretation: parse_rate 0.75 -> 1.00 over 48 tasks; the original scoreboard measured transport failure

defects.old_behavior: _score_task graded an empty prediction; unnecessary_call_rate = float(pred not in {TOOL_NONE,ABSTAIN}) awarded 1.0 (max badness) to a non-response
defects.why_invalid: conflates 'we failed to read the teacher' with 'the teacher chose badly'. Across teachers, whichever model we parse worse loses on capability axes for non-capability reasons.
affected_verdicts: all per-capability comparisons before the fix
defects.fix: unparsed rows carry no scores and are excluded from means; each axis reports {mean, n}; parse_rate tracked separately; _parse_action returns '' rather than the first whitespace token
defects.new_interpretation: no capability has a statistically established winner at n=4-15/axis

defects.old_behavior: p1_eval._propose_case passed raw_value into generate_target_line; build_target_candidates emitted 'ASSERTED: {raw_value}' etc, so the gold span was present by construction
defects.why_invalid: exact_gold_span_rate=1.0 measured the candidate builder, not the model. A random-init control scored 0.6618 on the same metric.
defects.fix: generate_target_line/_propose_case/evaluate_native_p1_suite take constrained: bool; --unconstrained CLI flag; results carry decoding_mode and span_metrics_are_tautological
defects.new_interpretation: under free generation the native100 checkpoint covers 0/150 gold atoms; transport was never demonstrated

defects.old_behavior: hash_tokens did `for ch in text[:64]`; _char_for_token scanned only range(32,127) so newline/tab/CR decoded to '?'
defects.why_invalid: span-port prompts average 530 chars, so the model received 12.1% of its input, cut off mid-word, and the gold value was frequently outside its view. Turn separators were corrupted in 224/224 corpus sources. Every call site already applied [: cfg.max_seq] with max_seq=512, so the inner cap defeated the caller's intent.
affected_metrics: every native training and evaluation metric
affected_verdicts: ALL native architecture rankings — the models could not see their inputs
defects.fix: truncation is the caller's decision (max_len, default None); detokenize uses the exact inverse chr(token_id-1)
defects.new_interpretation: native results to date carry no information about mechanisms; rankings must be re-derived from scratch

defects.old_behavior: student_gap_v1._suite_metrics averaged per-case `aggregate` COUNT fields across cases as if they were rates; _qwen38_c2 wrapped the result in min(1.0, x); _managed_ref_c2 returned hardcoded literals
defects.why_invalid: a case with two correct atoms contributed 2, so the mean exceeded 1.0 — Qwen3.8 reported assertion_state_correct = 1.0078. The clamp turned an impossible value into a perfect score, masking the defect. The managed reference was never measured at all, and its hardcoded coverage 0.7867 was in fact the assertion rate in the wrong slot.
defects.fix: atom-level rates with explicit numerator/denominator and Wilson intervals; clamp removed; both references measured from real artifacts
defects.regression_test: covered by student_gap_v1 regeneration; metric contract enforced in artifacts/campaign/measurement_repair_v1.json
defects.new_interpretation: gap vs managed ref is -0.055 (not -0.320), CIs overlap, NOT established. QLoRA gate flips to LOCKED. A real -0.152 gap remains vs Qwen3.8 (CIs disjoint).

defects.old_behavior: 100M-parameter architecture rankings drawn from p1_distill_train_v1: 96 examples, 4,516 characters, 33 epochs
defects.why_invalid: 0.0000452 tokens/param. Against the project's own historical Nano (3.15M params on 32.8M tokens = 10.4 tok/param) the program scaled parameters UP 31.7x while scaling tokens DOWN 7,263x — ~443,000x under a Chinchilla-optimal budget. Train loss in that regime measures memorisation.
defects.fix: corpus factory (nanoscribe/native/corpus/) producing R30 (14.7M char-level tokens) and P100 (36.8M) with leakage/coverage/dedupe gates; tiny corpus reclassified NATIVE_UNIT_OVERFIT_FIXTURE
defects.regression_test: nanoscribe/test_native_corpus.py (9 pins incl. leakage, partition disjointness, determinism)
defects.new_interpretation: no arm separated from a random-init control; ranking must be re-derived on the real corpus

infrastructure_defects.detail: pip install -r requirements.txt replaced the pod template's torch with 2.11.0+cu130 (CUDA 13.0) on a CUDA 12.4 driver; torch.cuda.is_available() False while device_count 1. The remote PREFLIGHT_OVERRIDE path then let it train on CPU.
infrastructure_defects.fix: bootstrap installs requirements EXCEPT torch; remote script hard-fails on torch.cuda.is_available() False

invariants: a count or per-encounter average must never be named as accuracy
case-level and atom-level rates are reported separately
